facts: Viking states it is actively seeking investments through direct ownership or joint ventures.
Viking states an acquisition size range of $10M to $75M+.
Viking explicitly lists industrial among its investment types.
Viking targets Midwest, Southeast, and Southwest U.S. markets.
Viking publicly identifies Aaron Werbel as Vice President of Acquisitions and Michael Arnovitz as Director of Acquisitions.
Viking's August 6, 2025 release documents a $50.4M off-market acquisition of a 409,000-square-foot small-bay industrial portfolio in Florida.
